sql:
SELECT
  family,
  family_label,
  SUM(CASE WHEN seniority IN ('senior', 'staff+', 'manager+') THEN listings_with_pay ELSE 0 END) AS senior_or_above_with_pay,
  SUM(listings_with_pay) AS total_with_pay
FROM mart_comp_by_family
WHERE
  seniority IS NULL AND listings_with_pay > 0
GROUP BY
  family,
  family_label
